value.body: A pharmacist dispenses prescribed medicines, checks prescriptions for errors and advises patients on correct use. Hospitals, retail and chain pharmacies, and government health services hire pharmacists. A typical day is dispensing, stock and expiry checks, and patient counselling.

items.label: Registration
items.note: Under the Pharmacy Act, 1948; overseen by the Pharmacy Council of India

value.title: How you get in
value.body: After the course, register with the State Pharmacy Council. Freshers join hospital or retail pharmacies as pharmacists; government pharmacist posts come through state health department and staff selection notices.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Knowledge of drug interactions and dosing

value.title: At a glance
items: Retail pharmacy pay is often modest; hospital and clinical roles may offer more growth.
A registered pharmacist is required to run a licensed pharmacy, which allows opening one's own.
An M.Pharm or Pharm.D opens clinical, industry and teaching roles.

competition.note: B.Pharm graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
